description: This file defines multiple data pipe classes for combining, splitting, and multiplexing data streams in the torch.utils.data.datapipes.iter module, including ConcaterIterDataPipe, ForkerIterDataPipe, DemultiplexerIterDataPipe, MultiplexerIterDataPipe, and ZipperIterDataPipe.

classes.name: ConcaterIterDataPipe
classes.description: Concatenates multiple Iterable DataPipes, yielding all elements from each in sequence.

classes.name: ForkerIterDataPipe
classes.description: Creates multiple instances of the same Iterable DataPipe, managing buffers and state for each.

classes.name: _ContainerTemplate
classes.description: Abstract base class defining required methods for container DataPipes.

classes.name: _ForkerIterDataPipe
classes.description: Implements buffer management and iteration logic for ForkerIterDataPipe.

classes.name: _ChildDataPipe
classes.description: Represents a child DataPipe instance that retrieves elements from the main DataPipe based on instance ID.

classes.name: DemultiplexerIterDataPipe
classes.description: Splits an input DataPipe into multiple DataPipes based on a classifier function.

classes.name: _DemultiplexerIterDataPipe
classes.description: Manages buffers and classification for splitting data into multiple streams.

classes.name: MultiplexerIterDataPipe
classes.description: Yields one element at a time from multiple input DataPipes in turn.

classes.name: ZipperIterDataPipe
classes.description: Aggregates elements from multiple DataPipes into tuples, stopping at the shortest.

methods.name: get_next_element_by_instance
methods.description: Retrieves the next element for a specific instance ID in Forker and Demux DataPipes.

methods.name: is_every_instance_exhausted
methods.description: Checks if all instances in Forker and Demux DataPipes are exhausted.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state for Forker and Demux DataPipes.

methods.name: _set_main_datapipe_valid_iterator_id
methods.description: Updates the valid iterator ID for ChildDataPipe instances.

methods.name: _check_valid_iterator_id
methods.description: Checks if the iterator ID is valid for the DataPipe.
